title: TALES: A Taxonomy and Analysis of Cultural Representations in LLM-generated Stories
findings: LLMs frequently generate cultural misrepresentations, with 88% of stories containing errors. These include misrepresentations of religious elements, such as factual errors about religious sites (e.g., location of a statue), violation of religious norms (e.g., selling meat near the Golden Temple), and logical inconsistencies (e.g., a Christian priest in a Hindu temple). These religious and cultural errors were found to negatively correlate with the perceived relatability of the stories.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured cultural misrepresentations in LLM-generated stories about India, which included inaccuracies and logical inconsistencies related to religious practices, norms, places, and figures. For example, it identified violations of religious customs (serving meat near a Sikh temple), factual errors about religious history, and logical impossibilities (a Christian priest in a Hindu temple).
